description: After order_execute confirms a supplier order, record the matching DRAFT purchase order in your own system so the books match. Always a draft: a person confirms it there. Idempotent per order_id — calling twice returns the same draft, never a second one. Needs both inventory and checkout permission. Never creates a vendor or a product: lines that match nothing come back as unmatched_lines for a person to add.

agent_id.description: Agent id; needs both inventory and checkout permission

connection_id.description: Which connected system, when the org has several

order_id.description: Conduit order id of a supplier order already placed with order_execute

session_token.description: Session token from agent_authenticate — required whenever agent_id is passed

name: inventory_purchase_order
title: Record a purchase order
